description: Render external/cross-product nodes in the roadmap dependency graph so it can serve as the live cross-product dashboard (the surface that replaces foreign ROADMAP.md rows under COMP-ROADMAP-MIGRATE option C). Today the vision adapter drops external-prefixed nodes (lib/roadmap-graph/vision-adapter.js:85) — they're known-but-not-rendered. Add an opt-in mode that renders external/owned-elsewhere codes as reference nodes (resolving status read-only from the owning repo's feature.json), so forge-top's graph shows the full cross-product picture. Sibling of COMP-ROADMAP-GRAPH-2. Anchor: docs/plans/2026-06-21-roadmap-planning-model-design.md. LABEL PARITY (added 2026-09-11, from SmartMemory ROADMAP-MIGRATE-1): lib/roadmap-graph/template.html is 194 lines against SmartMemory's hand-maintained 2,779-line graph (370 nodes, 228 typed edges, leverage + trackRank scoring, search/filter/export). Node labels are hard-coded to folder name at server/feature-scan.js:538, so generated nodes render as `CODE\nCODE` — the 370 curated labels have no source field to come from. Generating over that graph today would lose them. Scope addition: a label source field on the node, and parity with the curated graph's scoring and filtering before any regenerate is offered as an upgrade path.
